criteria: Main flow: discovery, intake, enrichment and user decisions. Posting freshness is background maintenance. Enrichment: measured fit, salary, posting-based degree evidence and Writer-calculated final score with model provenance; posting freshness is independent background maintenance. Review queue: open and undecided, not a recommendation to apply. Closed postings are separate exits from processing. No canonical bucket changes.
